name: Bakunyuu Onsen ~Inran Okami Etsuraku no Yu Hen~
original_name: 爆乳温泉 ～淫乱女将悦楽の湯篇～
source:
The main character, Seiji Naguro, was fed up with his ever-stagnant life.
He couldn't stop thinking about the inn owner, Enaga Yurie, whom he had noticed when he stayed at a japanese-style inn.
He decides to book into the inn for a long period of time, and he uses every trick in the book to try and take the voluptuous landlady's hand. He also makes a move on another mysterious guest, Kasazaki Kodama, and Daizen Ryoko, a young wife. 
The "Bakunyu Peach Blossom Hot Springs" are about to escalate into a dangerously steamy situation!
translation:
主角名黑征司厌倦了自己一成不变的生活。
他不停地想起自己在日式旅馆住宿时注意到的旅馆老板江永由理。
他决定长期住进客栈，使出浑身解数，试图抓住妖艳女老板娘的手。他还对另一位神秘客人笠崎儿玉和年轻妻子大善凉子采取了行动。
“巴昆玉桃花温泉”即将升级为险象环生！
